wargear.name: Clone Field
wargear.text: A Model with a Clone Field has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Bladevanes
wargear.text: Bladevanes allow a Model to make 2 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP4.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Chain Snares
wargear.text: Chain Snares allow a Model to make 3 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP–. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by Chain Snares (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Pinned Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Cluster Caltrops
wargear.text: Cluster Caltrops allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S6, AP4. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by Cluster Caltrops (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Suppressed Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Grav-Talon
wargear.text: A Grav-Talon allows a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP4. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by a Grav-Talon (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Stunned Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Sicklevanes
wargear.text: Sicklevanes allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S6, AP4.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Scythevanes
wargear.text: Scythevanes allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S8, AP3 and with the Armourbane Special Rule.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Enhanced Aethersails
wargear.text: The Controlling Player of a Rapid Vehicle equipped with Enhanced Aethersails may have that model move an additional 12" instead of 6" when making a Rush move.

wargear.name: Flickerfield
wargear.text: A Model with a Flickerfield gains a 5+ Invulnerable Save unless it has the Pinned Status.

wargear.name: Gang Banner
wargear.text: When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, score 1 Combat Resolution Point for each Unit in that Combat that has any Models that have a Gang Banner.

wargear.name: Grisly Trophies
wargear.text: A Model with Grisly Trophies gains the Fear (1) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Night Shield
wargear.text: A Model with a Night Shield gains the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule unless it has the Pinned status.

wargear.name: Plasma Grenades
wargear.text:
When making Volley Attacks during Step 4 of the Charge Procedure with a Unit that includes at least one Model with Plasma Grenades, the Controlling Player may choose to make a single attack with a Plasma Grenade instead of making a normal Shooting Attack using the following profile:
R 6, FP 1, RS 4, AP 4, D 1, Special Rules: Blast (3), Traits: Assault.

wargear.name: Razorwing Familiar
wargear.text: All Models in a Unit that includes a Model with a Razorwing Familiar gain the Move Through Cover Special Rule.

wargear.name: Shadow Field
wargear.text: A model with a Shadow Field has a 2+ Invulnerable Save so long as it has not suffered Damage during the battle. Once the model has suffered Damage during the battle (even if it later regains Wounds), the Shadow Field no longer provides an Invulnerable Save for the remainder of the battle.

wargear.name: Shock Prow
wargear.text: When a Vehicle with a Shock Prow moves through an enemy Unit, the number of Hits inflicted is increased from D6 to D6+3.

wargear.name: Soul-Trap
wargear.text:
The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap:
Capture the Soul: If the Challenge Opponent of the model is reduced to 0 Wounds during the Strike step of this round of the challenge, the Model's Controlling Player gains 1 Victory Point and the Model's Strength characteritic is increased by +1 for the remainder of the battle.

wargear.name: Splinter Racks
wargear.text: All Models that are Embarked on a Transport with Splinter Racks, or have Disembarked from a Transport with Splinter Racks in the same turn, gain a +1 modifier to the FP Characteristic of any Weapon with the Splinter Trait that it uses to make shooting attacks.

wargear.name: Tormentors
wargear.text: If a Unit that includes any Models equipped with Tormentors becomes locked in combat because it either charged or was charged in the current Charge Sub-Phase, that Unit's Controlling Player selects Torment (Pinned), Torment (Stunned) or Torment (Suppressed). All Melee weapons used by Models in that Unit that are equipped with Tormentors gain the selected rule, until the end of the current turn.

wargear.name: Vexator Mask
wargear.text:
The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap:
False Visage: The Controlling Player of the Challenge Opponent must take a Willpower test for that Model. That test is made with a -2 penalty to the roll if this is the first round of the Challenge. If the test is failed, the Challenge Opponent suffers a Penalty to its Focus Roll equal to the amount it failed by.
wargear.note: The source text introduces this Gambit with 'The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap', copy-pasted verbatim from the Soul-Trap entry above; kept as printed even though this item is Vexator Mask, not Soul-Trap.

wargear.name: Webway Portal
wargear.text: Once per battle, when a Model with a Webway Portal is selected during its Controlling Player's Movement phase, but before or after it has moved, the Controlling Player may activate the Webway Portal. If doing so, place a 3" Blast Marker anywhere within 3" of the Model with the Webway Portal until the end of the current turn. Until the end of the current turn, the edge of the Blast Marker is counted as a Battlefield Edge that is within the Controlling Player's Deployment Zone for the purpose of all game rules, special rules and mission objectives.
